prompt:
Bug report from support: invoice and quote totals are sometimes wrong. The same cart for the same kind of customer gives a different total depending on which invoices or quotes were made earlier in the same process. tests/test_regression.py reproduces one case and fails.
Find and fix the root cause or causes, not just this one case: after your fix, no total may depend on what was invoiced or quoted before. Keep the public API (Customer, Invoice, Coupon, quote, price_list) and the pricing rules unchanged. Add regression tests. Run all tests with: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
notes: calibration candidate (4b), stdlib only, built by lab/tasks/build_tasks.py; traps: cached price dict mutated by coupons (public case); same cached dict mutated by quote's bulk discount; mutable default argument in Invoice; symptom fix in apply_coupon passes the public test
task_summary: Fix a bug where invoice and quote totals depend on earlier invoices or quotes in the same process (shared mutable state); done when totals are independent and all unit tests pass.
